# x402 Web Markdown Scraper

> Pay-per-request web scraping API and MCP server for AI agents: any URL or PDF to clean Markdown.
> Pay USDC on Base (eip155:8453) over HTTP 402 (x402 v2). No account or API key. Category: Data.
> Full reference with schemas and payment payloads: https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/llms-full.txt

Base: https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com
Pay to: 0xf84EF3669eA39b87D4a850B4510f7aCBAC19be5f
Asset: USDC on Base. Networks: eip155:8453, eip155:84532

## Free (no payment)

- [Health](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/health): GET /health — keep-alive liveness
- [Catalog](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/catalog): GET /v1/catalog — machine-readable SKUs
- [OpenAPI](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/openapi.json): GET /openapi.json — request/response schemas
- [MCP server](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/mcp): POST /mcp — Streamable HTTP MCP; tools/call paid via x402 in _meta
- [MCP](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/.well-known/mcp): GET /.well-known/mcp — agent tool card
- [Plugin](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): GET /.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- [llms.txt](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/llms.txt): this file
- [llms-full.txt](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/llms-full.txt): full reference — schemas, x402 headers, sample payloads, USDC contract
- [Playground](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/#playground): try every SKU from a browser wallet
- Python client: `pip install x402-scraper`

## Paid (x402)

Call a paid path without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE to receive HTTP 402 and PAYMENT-REQUIRED.
Retry the same URL with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE to settle Exact EVM USDC.

- [Markdown scrape](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/scrape?url=https://example.com): GET /v1/scrape?url= — $0.01 USDC. Converts any web article URL into clean, stripped Markdown for AI context windows.
- [Executive summary](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/summary?url=https://example.com): GET /v1/summary?url= — $0.02 USDC. Scrape a URL and return a 3-bullet executive summary plus clean Markdown.
- [Page metadata](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/extract-metadata?url=https://example.com): GET /v1/extract-metadata?url= — $0.01 USDC. Extract Open Graph, Schema.org JSON-LD, author, publish date, word count, and reading time.
- [PDF to markdown](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/parse-pdf?url=https://example.com/paper.pdf): GET /v1/parse-pdf?url= — $0.05 USDC. Fetch a PDF URL and return stripped, structured Markdown of the document text.
- [Deep site crawl](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/deep-crawl?url=https://example.com&max_depth=2): GET /v1/deep-crawl?url= — $0.15 USDC. Crawl a starting URL up to 3 internal levels and return a structured multi-page document map.
- [Title + description](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/title?url=https://example.com): GET /v1/title?url= — $0.001 USDC. Return the page title and meta description only.
- [Plain text](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/text?url=https://example.com): GET /v1/text?url= — $0.005 USDC. Return visible page text without HTML.
- [Heading outline](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/outline?url=https://example.com): GET /v1/outline?url= — $0.005 USDC. Return h1-h3 headings as a document outline.
- [Outbound links](https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/links?url=https://example.com): GET /v1/links?url= — $0.005 USDC. Return up to 50 absolute http(s) links from the page.

## Primary SKU

GET/POST https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/scrape costs $0.01 USDC. Query or JSON body: {"url": "..."}.
GET/POST https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/summary costs $0.02 USDC. Returns 3-bullet summary + markdown.
GET/POST https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/extract-metadata costs $0.01 USDC. Returns Open Graph, JSON-LD, author, date, word count.
GET/POST https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/parse-pdf costs $0.05 USDC. PDF URL to structured Markdown.
GET/POST https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/deep-crawl costs $0.15 USDC. Internal crawl, max_depth 1-3.

## Optional SKUs

GET /v1/title $0.001, GET /v1/text $0.005, GET /v1/outline $0.005, GET /v1/links $0.005.
